{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
# First, remove commas from the revenue strings
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)

# Now convert to numeric
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Ensure 'status' is 'completed' for valid sales
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the structure of the data
sales_df.head(), sales_df.shape"}
